اجلعببت (form IVq)
# اِجْلَعْبَبْتُ (ijlaʕbabtu) /id͡ʒ.laʕ.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
# اِجْلَعْبَبْتَ (ijlaʕbabta) /id͡ʒ.laʕ.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
# اِجْلَعْبَبْتِ (ijlaʕbabti) /id͡ʒ.laʕ.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
